Name: Enricher Tinker
Author: ninjor1
Description:
[size=5][b]Enricher Tinker[/b][/size]

Makes the Enricher sprinkler attachment hold more, and do more.

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]9 fertilizer slots:[/b] an Enricher holds a 3x3 grid of fertilizer stacks instead of one. Enrichers you've already placed get the extra slots too.[/*]
[*][b]Several fertilizers per seed:[/b] with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21318]Ultimate Fertilizer[/url] set to [font=Courier New]multi-fertilizer-stack[/font], planting a seed in range applies every fertilizer in the Enricher which can go on the tile, so one Enricher can apply Speed-Gro, Quality Fertilizer and Retaining Soil together. Without it, the first fertilizer which fits is used, and the next stack takes over when it runs out.[/*]
[*][b]Infinite fertilizer (optional):[/b] fertilizer in an Enricher is never used up.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]
Settings are in [font=Courier New]config.json[/font], and can be changed in-game with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]. "Apply every fertilizer" is greyed out unless Ultimate Fertilizer is set to [font=Courier New]multi-fertilizer-stack[/font], and its tooltip says why. In multiplayer, the player planting the seed uses their own settings.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url][/*]
[*]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21318]Ultimate Fertilizer[/url], for several fertilizers per seed[/*]
[*]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], to change settings in-game[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installing[/b][/size]
Unzip it into your game's [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.

[size=4][b]Source code, bugs and suggestions[/b][/size]
The source code is on GitHub: [url=https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods]https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods[/url]
Please report bugs and suggestions as [url=https://github.com/fnielson1/stardew-valley-mods/issues]GitHub issues[/url] rather than on the Bugs or Posts tabs here.
